description: This file defines the Importer class responsible for importing various note formats (e.g., Aegis, Evernote, Google Keep, Plaintext, Simplenote) into the application. It includes methods for detecting the note type from a file and converting files into internal payloads, as well as inserting these payloads into the application's data store.

classes.name: Importer
classes.description: A class responsible for detecting note formats from files, converting files into internal payloads, and importing them into the application's data store.

methods.name: detectService
methods.description: Asynchronously detects the type of note service (e.g., 'evernote', 'aegis', 'google-keep', 'simplenote', 'plaintext') based on file content and extension.

methods.name: getPayloadsFromFile
methods.description: Converts a file into one or more DecryptedTransferPayload objects based on the specified note type.

methods.name: importFromTransferPayloads
methods.description: Inserts an array of DecryptedTransferPayload objects into the application's data store.
